meta.title: Xiaomi MiMo TTS
meta.description: Add Xiaomi MiMo and Doubao text-to-speech to DSH, audio history and downloads, browser speech fallback, and optional UI sound effects.

en.settings.announcementsApprovalsHint: Announce new approval requests in the current conversation. Off by default; stops when answered or withdrawn.
en.settings.announcementsHint: Enable speech and keep DSH Web open. Collected messages received while speech is busy are skipped without replay.
en.settings.announcementsJobsHint: Announce observed background jobs finishing, failing or being cancelled in the current conversation. Off by default; requires the DSH jobs service.
en.settings.announcementsPetHint: Read pet musings, chat replies and broadcast text.
en.settings.announcementsQuestionsHint: Follows autoplay and reads only the current question title. Stops when the question changes or the card closes.
en.settings.announcementsWhaleHint: Accept speech requested by Whale Musume through the speech API. Enabled by default.
en.settings.apiKeyFocusCopy2: Don't worry, I can't see a thing
en.settings.apiKeyFocusCopy4: Take your time—your secret is safe
en.settings.apiKeyIdleCopy2: Is the key safely tucked away?
en.settings.apiKeyIdleCopy3: Save it, then we're on air!
en.settings.apiKeyLoading: Reading the saved key status from the Host…
en.settings.apiKeyMissing: No key is saved for this provider. Enter and save one before previewing speech.
en.settings.apiKeyPendingClear: Saving will clear the saved key. A base key will be inherited if one is configured.
en.settings.apiKeyPendingSave: This key is waiting to be saved. Previews will use it only after saving.
en.settings.apiKeyRecognized: A MiMo API key is saved and its format is recognized. Use Broadcast Desk to confirm the connection.
en.settings.apiKeyStatus: An existing key changes only when you save a new value.

en.settings.apiKeyUnsupported: The key format is not recognized. Check that it starts with sk- or tp-.
en.settings.apiKeyUnsupportedSaved: The saved key format is not recognized. Enter a replacement or clear the saved key.
en.settings.autoPlayHint: The browser may reject automatic playback.
en.settings.autoPlayOffLabel: Call me when you need me
en.settings.description: Generate and play Xiaomi MiMo TTS audio from assistant message actions.
en.settings.doubaoCloneHint: Enter an existing cloned voice ID from the Doubao console.
en.settings.doubaoKeyConfigured: Doubao API key configured. Preview to check model and voice access.
en.settings.doubaoStreamingHint: Text is appended to one session while audio plays during generation.
en.settings.doubaoVoiceRequired: Enter a voice ID for the selected Doubao model.
en.settings.enabledHint: Disabling it hides voice settings and turns off automatic playback.
en.settings.formatMp3Hint: Plays after the complete file is generated. Smaller file size; supports pause and resume.
en.settings.formatPcmHint: Plays chunks as they arrive for a shorter wait; supports pause and resume. Falls back to MP3 if streaming fails before the first audio chunk.
en.settings.formatWavHint: Plays after the complete lossless file is generated. Larger file size; supports pause and resume.
en.settings.localSpeechAutoHint: Uses the selected cloud voice first and falls back to local speech before playback starts.
en.settings.localSpeechDisabledHint: Uses only the selected cloud voice and never falls back to local speech.
en.settings.localSpeechFirstHint: Uses browser-local speech first and tries the selected cloud voice if it fails.
en.settings.localSpeechUnavailableHint: No browser voices are available, so only cloud-first speech can be used.
en.settings.modelAutoPlayHintPreset: Preset voices use low-latency streaming automatically.
en.settings.modelAutoPlayHintVoiceDesign: Custom voice design supports automatic playback only after the reply is complete.
en.settings.previewDefaultText: Hi! I'm Whale Maid. It's lovely to explore the world of voices with you!
en.settings.previewDefaultTextHumor: My alarm rang. I voted for five more minutes in bed. An hour later, the motion was still in effect.
en.settings.previewDefaultTextInspiration: Go at your own pace. A seed still blooms after a late spring. One stumble need not end your journey.
en.settings.previewDefaultTextPoetry: The wind folds clouds into a letter; the moon signs it. May starlight find you on every road home.
en.settings.previewDefaultTextReflection: We cannot keep every breeze, but we can choose our sail. Perhaps the answer is in how we live today.
en.settings.previewErrorApiKeyMissing: No API key is saved for this provider. Save one first, or enable local speech.
en.settings.previewErrorApiKeyRejected: The speech provider rejected this key. Check or replace the API key.
en.settings.previewErrorAutoplay: The browser blocked playback. Tap preview again.
en.settings.previewErrorBufferLimit: Audio buffer limit reached. Playback stopped.
en.settings.previewErrorLocalUnavailable: This browser has no available local voice.
en.settings.previewErrorRateLimited: The speech service rate limit was reached. Try again shortly.
en.settings.previewErrorResourceUnavailable: This key does not have access to the selected Doubao resource.
en.settings.previewErrorTimeout: Speech synthesis timed out. Check the network and try again.
en.settings.previewErrorVoiceUnavailable: Voice unavailable. Check its ID, model and access permissions.
en.settings.previewFailed: Preview failed. Check the settings and network.
en.settings.previewHint: Save a provider key to preview speech; browser speech may be used when no key is configured
en.settings.previewPlayingDoubao: Doubao is playing. Tap again to stop.
en.settings.previewPlayingLocal: Browser-local speech is playing—tap again to stop
en.settings.previewPlayingMimo: MiMo speech is playing—tap again to stop
en.settings.previewSaveKeyFirst: Save the API key before previewing.
en.settings.readScopeFirstSegmentHint: Both automatic and manual playback read only the opening segment.
en.settings.readScopeFullHint: Both automatic and manual playback read the full reply.
en.settings.readScopeSmartHint: Automatic playback reads short replies in full. For long replies, it reads the opening two segments and may add a brief closing cue when substantial content remains. Manual playback reads the full reply.
en.settings.secretPlaceholder: Enter a new key for this provider
en.settings.soundEffectsDescription: Bringing semantic UISFX interface sounds to DSH. Explore more sounds in DSH...
en.settings.soundEffectsSupported: Supported sounds: Start, Complete, Success, Error, Notification, Press, Select, Toggle On, Toggle Off, Send, Open, Close, Delete, Stop, Queued
en.settings.speechInstructionArgumentPrompt: Sound as if debating someone, with a defiant and confrontational attitude.
en.settings.speechInstructionBeijingPrompt: Read this text in a natural Beijing Chinese accent with a little erhua, like casual conversation.
en.settings.speechInstructionCalmPrompt: Speak with a calm, composed and restrained tone.
en.settings.speechInstructionCantonesePromp: Read this text in natural, idiomatic Cantonese, like an everyday conversation.
en.settings.speechInstructionCheerfulPrompt: Speak with a bright, happy and energetic tone.
en.settings.speechInstructionCoyPrompt: Speak in a soft, affectionate, slightly dependent tone with playful charm.
en.settings.speechInstructionCutePrompt: Use a higher, light and sweet voice with a cute, slightly playful delivery.
en.settings.speechInstructionDongbeiPrompt: Read this text in natural Northeastern Chinese with a warm, conversational tone.
en.settings.speechInstructionGentlePrompt: Speak in a gentle, warm and natural tone.
en.settings.speechInstructionHenanPrompt: Read this text in natural Henan Chinese, like an everyday conversation.
en.settings.speechInstructionHint: Describe emotion, tone or delivery; leave blank for the default. Results vary by voice.
en.settings.speechInstructionLimitations:
Xiaomi and Doubao standard TTS share these presets and save instructions separately.
Results depend on the model, voice and text. Dialects, tears and whispers may not be reproduced accurately, and results can differ between providers.
Browser speech does not support these instructions; Doubao cloning is not supported here. Preview first.
en.settings.speechInstructionPlaceholder: For example: sound a little shy, with gentle anticipation.
en.settings.speechInstructionShaanxiPrompt: Read this text in natural Shaanxi Chinese, like an everyday conversation.
en.settings.speechInstructionShanghaiPrompt: Read this text in natural Shanghainese, like an everyday conversation.
en.settings.speechInstructionShyPrompt: Sound shy and hesitant, while revealing warmth and anticipation of growing closer.
en.settings.speechInstructionSichuanPrompt: Read this text in a natural Sichuan Chinese accent, like an everyday conversation.
en.settings.speechInstructionStoryPrompt: Tell the text like a story, letting emotion follow the content naturally.
en.settings.speechInstructionTearfulPrompt: Speak with a trembling voice on the verge of tears, a little choked with sadness and hurt.
en.settings.speechInstructionTianjinPrompt: Read this text in natural Tianjin Chinese, like an everyday conversation.
en.settings.speechInstructionWearyPrompt: Use a low, slightly husky voice, as if confiding after a hard life, with weary loneliness.
en.settings.speechInstructionWhisperPrompt: Speak softly as if sharing a secret close to the listener, with an intimate ASMR quality.
en.settings.title: Text To Speech (Xiaomi MiMo)
en.settings.voiceDesignPlaybackCompleteHint: Generates the entire reply before playback for better continuity.
en.settings.voiceDesignPlaybackFirstSegment: Generates and plays only the first segment for a faster start and lower usage.
en.settings.voiceDesignPlaybackSegmentedHin: Generates and plays semantic segments in order; better for long text and faster start.
en.settings.voiceDesignPromptHint: Describe the voice itself with age/gender, texture, pace, and emotional baseline; avoid scenes or actions.
en.settings.voiceRateHint:
Range: 0.5×–2.0×; 1.0× is the original speed.
Doubao: applied during synthesis, starting with the next synthesis.
Xiaomi and browser speech: adjusted during playback. Xiaomi streaming also changes pitch.
en.settings.voiceReadingAutoPlayHint: New replies are read aloud automatically; turning this on also enables voice reading.
en.settings.voiceReadingHintDoubaoCloned: Doubao voice cloning uses a voice ID; pick an ID you have used before.
en.settings.voiceReadingHintVoiceDesign: Voice design generates a voice from a description; picking a preset also updates the description.
en.settings.voiceReadingIntro: Pick the reading voice and control automatic playback and interface sounds. Changes are written to this plugin's speech settings immediately.
en.settings.voiceReadingReadOnly: Settings are read-only in this deployment and cannot be saved.
en.settings.voiceReadingSaveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
en.settings.voiceReadingUnavailable: This deployment does not provide voice settings.
